title: The eternal complement
text: Advanced AI may matter most for the routine work behind breakthrough ideas. Explore why execution could shape the next economy and the pace of progress.

title: Amazon releases its own Jev clone as decision models flood the web
text: Amazon Web Services' Strand Labs has released the latest Jevalike decision model, Strands Decider 2B.

title: Shopify debuts Canvas, a way to build online stores by chatting with AI
text: Shopify’s new Canvas site builder lets merchants create and customize their online stores by chatting with its AI agent Sidekick, while watching the changes happen in real time.

title: How Albertsons Companies is reimagining retail from the inside out
text: Albertsons Cos. is using ChatGPT Enterprise and the OpenAI API to help teams work faster and make grocery shopping easier for millions of customers.

title: Brian Chesky interview: AI agents need their own operating system
text: Brian Chesky on making Airbnb agent-friendly, the state of consumer AI, and why the world needs an AI-native operating system.

title: Photon held a funeral for mobile apps. Now it has $4.5M to help replace them with agents.
text: The startup helps developers build AI agents that work over iMessage, SMS/RCS, email, and other messaging platforms. It's a bet that consumers will increasingly use agents instead of downloading apps.

title: Hearing tech startup Legato launches its AI hearing glasses
text: The glasses stem from the startup’s goal of making hearing care more accessible by addressing the cost, comfort, and stigma associated with traditional hearing aids.

title: Satlyt, founded by a former Google and SpaceX product manager, raises $8M to run AI on satellites
text: Satlyt wants to be the Android of orbital computing, offering open software that works on many companies' satellites, versus SpaceX's closed, all-in-one iPhone-style approach.

title: Google releases Gemini 4 Argon, called its most powerful model yet
text: Google has released its latest Gemini model, marketing it as a workhorse for coding and cybersecurity work.

title: Valor, Atreides, and Sequoia back AI startup Flow Engineering at $750M valuation
text: Flow Engineering, which is bringing AI agents to hardware design, also landed Roelof Botha as an angel investor and board member.

text: There’s a reason frontier labs have gotten gun-shy about consumer AI — and it’s not because the tech isn’t good enough.

title: Meta disputes claim that Muse read a user’s private messages without permission
text: Meta says its Muse AI agent cannot access a user’s Messages without explicit permission, disputing a journalist’s account that the agent read his private messages while the required Mac setting was turned off.

title: DoorDash launches an AI agent you can text to order food
